comments.text:
Resolved in-chat 2026-04-23: **umbrella, four apps to start** (octo_pi_ai, octo_pi_agent, octo_pi_coder, octo_pi_tui). Peripheral apps (mom, future web) added lazily by their phase. No apps/shared.

Rationale: structural decomposition matches upstream's linear ai → agent → coder dep chain; per-app deps genuinely differ (tui has no HTTP client, ai has no terminal); leaves the door open to publish octo_pi_ai / octo_pi_agent as standalone Hex libs. Compiler enforces dep graph, not a linter.

Decision recorded in RESEARCH.md §7 Q1. Unblocks octo-w29.2 (Scaffold umbrella project with four apps).

description:
Resolve RESEARCH.md §7 Q1. Decide between Mix umbrella (four child apps) vs single app with enforced module boundaries (e.g., via `boundary` or `mix xref`).

Deliverable: a short decision note in RESEARCH.md §7 (or a new ADR file) with the call and rationale.

Default recommendation from research: lean umbrella. This spike is to validate and commit.
title: Spike: umbrella vs single-app layout
